But the 'when not to use' example is wrong: it says avoid when the body 'branches on ... the contents or size of the component sets', yet isAuthorized's own body branches on forbids.isEmpty && !permits.isEmpty (size/emptiness of the components) and the simp still closes, because any property of a component is preserved by component equality (congruence). The real break is when the body depends on something other than the components (the raw policies list, or an argument not held equal). Fix: reword the first avoid-when to say the body must depend only on the components, and it fails when the body reads anything outside the per-component equalities or the components don't share one lemma shape.
